summary: Narrow campus road with no parking convention and no room to pull off.
reasons: Through campus road, no cars parked
University buildings and dormitory close by

best_section.where: east edge of Upland Road at the top of the bend, beside the Brain Institute

drivers.seclusion: Backs onto trees and university buildings; service building 10 m away, dormitory 20 m, no homes within 10 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Road is narrow and the east edge is trees and kerb; one vehicle at the start but no clear pull-off.
drivers.traffic: Campus through road used by staff, students and service vehicles.
drivers.convention: No other cars parked along the kerb; signs show loading zone and no stopping.

flags: Signs show no stopping and a loading zone along this kerb
Several mapped bollards and gates close by
sun_shade: Heavily shaded by tree canopy on the east side; morning sun blocked.
